facts.note: was fought on 10 October 680 (10 Muharram in the year 61 AH of the Islamic calendar).
the second Umayyad caliph Yazid I (r. 680–683)

Shia Muslims mark the anniversary on Ashura ... beating their chests, and self-flagellating in some cases.
